note: Panel recipe for tools/panelize.py. Tabs are given as a point near the board edge (single-board coordinates, mm, KiCad front view) and the outward direction; the tool finds the exact edge. All copper stops 0.55 mm short of the edge; the nearest track (the LEDs' shared return ring) is 1.0 mm in. No tab on the right-hand flat (the switch knob) and none where an LED sits.

tabs.why: top, between the two top LEDs
bottom, where the cell slides in (file the nub flat)
left, the 9 o'clock gap in the LED ring
upper right, between two LEDs, clear of the switch
lower right, between two LEDs, clear of the switch
